title: Canonical quotient contraction and completed tensor associator roof
statement: Fix the prime, finite coefficient extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], scheme and ringed sequence site with reduction/limit adjunction $\mathcal R\dashv\mathcal L$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and a primitive tensor realization with its projection-normalized tensor model [def-sf-primitive-tensor-realization-data]. Write $v_{K,J}:K\widehat\otimes J\to\mathcal L(\mathcal RK\otimes\mathcal RJ)$ for that realization. Define the contraction $d_{K,J}$ to be $\mathcal R(v_{K,J})$ followed by the reduction/limit counit at $\mathcal RK\otimes\mathcal RJ$. Using the actual system associator of the fixed representative-normalized symmetric monoidal data [def-zl-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal-data], define the completed associator from $(X\widehat\otimes Y)\widehat\otimes Z$ to $X\widehat\otimes(Y\widehat\otimes Z)$, whenever $d_{Y,Z}$ is invertible, to be: the outer $v_{X\widehat\otimes Y,Z}$; then $\mathcal L$ of contraction $d_{X,Y}\otimes1$, the actual system associator, and $1\otimes d_{Y,Z}^{-1}$ in that order; then the inverse outer realization $v_{X,Y\widehat\otimes Z}^{-1}$. This defines the actual quotient-model roof; no equality with a transported constraint is asserted.
